nodes.speaker: Engineer
nodes.text: Hey! Welcome to the GridUp Arena. Everything here runs on grids and logic.

nodes.speaker: Engineer
text: GridUp is a grid-based builder tool. You place elements on a grid to create layouts, puzzles, or designs.
It's surprisingly versatile — people use it for floor plans, game levels, or just pixel art. Built with real-time collaboration in mind.

nodes.speaker: Engineer
nodes.text: The portal to GridUp is on the right. Jump in — no account needed, just start building.

nodes.speaker: Engineer
nodes.text: Check out the terminals around the room. Each one shows a different grid project. Portal's on the right when you're ready.

nodes.speaker: Engineer
nodes.text: Press ESC to head back outside. Build something cool!
